description: Submit text for an online text-entry assignment, exactly as given; the tool never writes content for you. Your instructor sees it and it counts as a submission attempt. [NEEDS CONFIRMATION: call it once for a preview and a confirm_token, show the preview to the user, and only if they say yes call it again with the same arguments, confirm=true and that confirm_token. Apps that can ask the user directly show a confirmation instead.]

assignment_id.description: Assignment ID (numeric string). Get it from list_assignments or list_upcoming_assignments.

confirm.description: Set to true together with confirm_token to carry out a request you already previewed.

confirm_token.description: The one-time token from the preview. Only use it after the user has said yes.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

name: submit_assignment_text
title: Submit Assignment Text
